Go ahead. Do I have to fill in anything first?
One form, two pages, and you hand it in to reception, not to me. That is the first thing.
And the second?

Understood. And the third?

Welcome, and here is everything you need before your first morning. You have to collect a badge from reception when you arrive, because the lifts do not work without one and nobody can let you in. That is the first thing, before coffee, before anything. Second, and this one is absolute. You must not take client documents out of the building, in any format, printed or on a screen. There is no version of that rule that has an exception in it. Third, the training session on Wednesday afternoon. It is recommended and it is genuinely useful, and it is not obligatory, so if your week is difficult you do not have to be there. Any questions, the number is on the badge.

Quick one about the report. It is due on Thursday at midday and the deadline has not moved, whatever anybody told you on Friday. Here is the problem. Two people have to approve it before it goes out, and one of those two is away until Wednesday afternoon, which gives us about four hours. So if you can get me the numbers on Tuesday instead of Wednesday, we are fine. One more thing, and this is good news. You do not have to rewrite the summary. Last quarter's version is still accurate and nobody is expecting a new one. Call me if any of that is a problem.
